description: Students of senior secondary classes (11-12) in government schools will study the basics of coding, programming and artificial intelligence (AI) from the next session.
body_lead: The Rajasthan education department will introduce basics of coding, programming and artificial intelligence for students of senior secondary classes (11-12) in government schools from the next academic session. The education department is among the first few in the country to complete the School Curriculum Framework (SCF) as mandated under the New Education Policy (NEP). It has identified 25 areas of importance as part of the curriculum.
